name: All in AI Tools

sources.title: Homepage — multilingual AI tools directory (20,000+ tools claimed)
Submit page — Free (reciprocal link + 90-day queue), Basic $49 fast-track, 3-credit pack $120, Sponsor $199.90/mo
Pricing/credits page — confirms paid review 2-6h vs free up to 90 days

conditions: Free submission requires adding their backlink code on your website homepage: All in AI Tools
Free path only accepts domains 6+ months old
Free review/inclusion can take up to 90 days
requirements: AI tool/product (directory is AI-tools-focused; has category tree including platforms like web/mac/iOS/chrome extensions)
Domain must be 6+ months old for the free tier
Reciprocal homepage link for free submissions (form has 'I added the All in AI website code' confirmation step)
Paid fast-track submissions skip the reciprocal-link requirement
preparation: Tool name, website URL, email (the free form's only fields)
For free tier: ability to place an HTML anchor on the product homepage
Decide tier: Free (link exchange, ≤90 days) vs Basic $49/site (2-6h review, dofollow detail page) vs 3-site credit pack $120 vs Sponsor $199.90/mo
workflow: Free route: place the required anchor tag on your homepage, tick 'I added the All in AI website code', submit tool name + URL + email, wait up to 90 days
Paid route: choose Basic/3-credit/Sponsor, pay via Stripe, submit details from the account dashboard; review ~2-6 hours
watchFor: Free tier is a link-exchange — verify the reciprocal-link requirement is acceptable before using it; removal of the badge may jeopardize the listing
Countdown-style 'Price returns to original soon' urgency pricing on paid tiers — standard directory pressure tactic
Directory includes an 'AI NSFW Tools' category — check brand-safety comfort
Aggressive partner upsell on the submit page (100Backlinks $499 package with discount code)
Submission credits lock website info after submission per FAQ
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page under allinai.tools/tools/<slug> or appears in its category listing, and shows on the homepage for free-tier inclusions per plan
unknowns: Whether free-tier listings actually get a dofollow link (only paid Basic explicitly promises 'dofollow detail page')
Whether homepage link placement is re-verified over time
